title: Phil Collins enters the Rock Hall as a solo artist: "You haven't heard the last of me"
summary: The singer was inducted for a second time at a ceremony in Los Angeles, alongside Oasis, Sade and Iron Maiden.
body:
Phil Collins was inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame as a solo artist on Saturday 14 November, at a ceremony at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles. He was first inducted in 2010 as a member of Genesis.

Blink-182 drummer Travis Barker inducted him, then joined Cynthia Erivo to perform "In the Air Tonight". Collins, who has not performed live since 2022, did not sing, but told the audience: "You haven't heard the last of me." His daughter, the actress Lily Collins, was in the crowd.

The class of 2026

This year's performer inductees also include Oasis, Iron Maiden, Sade, Billy Idol, Luther Vandross, Wu-Tang Clan and Joy Division/New Order. Oprah Winfrey inducted Vandross.

The ceremony will be broadcast on ABC and Disney+ in December.

Sources: Associated Press, Consequence, The Boston Globe.
